description: Rename a node in your durable memory. Give its current stem, then the new one (lowercase-hyphenated, not already in use). Every link to the node and to its blocks is rewritten to the new stem. Its description is not changed: update that separately if it no longer fits. Example: ["atlas-migration", "atlas-cutover"]. If the command exits with code 75 ("busy" or "changed on disk"), run the same command again.
